positions.as_written: Measure the active and passive ranges first, so the functional assessment has a measurement to interpret.
Ask what the patient cannot do, specifically, rather than whether the knee is stiff.
Ask about the tasks that need progressively more flexion: sitting, stairs, getting out of a car, cycling, kneeling and squatting.
Ask about tasks needing full extension: standing comfortably, walking without a limp and lying flat.
